listing.name: Real Bout Fatal Fury (Neo Geo) / Real-Bout-Fatal-Fury-Recomp (omegakatana92)
listing.summary: Native Windows x64 and Steam Deck AppImage static recompilation of Real Bout Fatal Fury (Neo Geo MVS/AES). The game's 68000 code is recompiled to C and runs on a neogeorecomp MVS board model with the real BIOS, not an emulator frontend. No ROMs or BIOS included. 100% native on tested sessions; YM2610 audio matched against MAME 0.242.
